scope: Mandatory isolated software X-authority core lifecycle, completion, properties, selections, focus, grabs, disconnect; extension discovery/negotiation/refusal and selected SHAPE/SYNC operations. Not full X11/extension semantics, WM policy, GPU, physical input or XTS5 certification.

XID reuse does not retain retired event subscriptions
DestroySubwindows restacked sibling order, empty and invalid targets
Disconnect destruction subscription addresses and healthy continuation
Mapped DestroyWindow automatically unmaps before destruction
XFixes selection changes, ordered notifications, masks, invalid subscriptions, teardown subtypes, subscriber XID reuse and self-delivery
XkbUseExtension XkbGetNames key type and level names resolvable by GetAtomName
GetGeometry rejects absent and destroyed drawables with BadDrawable and preserves continuation
CreatePixmap and FreePixmap lifecycle, extents, depth, InputOnly drawables and XID reuse, read back through GetImage
Graphics contexts: creation, ChangeGC, selected-component CopyGC, root/depth binding, value refusals and freed-context refusal
SetDashes refuses empty and zero dashes; SetClipRectangles confines output, an empty list disables it, clip-mask None restores it
ClearArea paints the background pixel, extends zero extents to the window edge, reports Expose only on request, refuses pixmaps and InputOnly windows
CopyArea copies a rectangle, reports NoExposure for a wholly available source and GraphicsExposure for the missing part, and is silent when graphics-exposures is False
CopyPlane expands one source plane into foreground and background pixels from any source depth and refuses non-single bit-planes
PolyPoint, PolyLine, PolySegment and PolyRectangle place the specified pixels in Origin and Previous modes
PolyFillRectangle, FillPoly and the arc requests fill the specified regions and truncate angles beyond 360 degrees
PutImage and GetImage round-trip ZPixmap and Bitmap data, honour plane-mask, clip outside images and refuse mismatched depth, pad, format and rectangles
QueryBestSize answers every class with nonzero sizes and refuses unknown classes, InputOnly tile/stipple queries and absent drawables
ForceScreenSaver accepts both defined modes and refuses any other
WarpPointer moves the pointer, honours its source rectangle, and refuses an unknown window
